Welcome to the [Data Analysis Project]{.attention} section! 
<!-- Here, you will find detailed instructions for the project in **MATH3085/6143**. -->

In this project, you will analyse survival (and mortality) data using `R`, present informative plots and interpret your findings using evidence from the supplied datasets.

The project instructions are available on Blackboard under `Assessments` → `Data Analysis Project`.

**Deadline:** Friday 11 December 2026 at 16:00 (UK time).
